opening.argument: The presentation provides concrete product-support information rather than a deceptive offer. It explains that "Intel Optane Memory is a smart memory technology that accelerate the computers responsiveness" and clarifies that it "does not replace DRAM entirely but rather it complements it," giving viewers an educational comparison with DRAM. It then directs viewers to Dell support to check compatibility by entering a service tag and to consult the PC setup guide. The displayed Dell support page and setup document reinforce those practical instructions. The subscription request and social-media handles are ordinary channel-support engagement, with no financial, credential, or other deceptive condition attached.
